import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    v = []
    for i in range(n):
        temp = int(data[1 + i])
        v.append(temp)
    
    # nth_element equivalent in Python: sort and get the middle element
    v.sort()
    print(v[n // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
